title: How do scam labels on incoming calls work?
body:
How do scam labels on incoming calls work?

Open Authenticity Check → **Call** tab → Incoming labels section → guide and Sync.

Numbers come only from ALADDIN's server.

A label appears on incoming calls when the number is listed. iOS 18+: Settings → Apps → Phone → Call Blocking & Identification → **ALADDIN Call Filter**.

This does not block every unknown caller — only labels known scam numbers.

ALADDIN does not listen to calls in real time (iOS rules). If you have a recording, check it in the Call tab after the conversation.
